name: PendingBusiness
_sources: Copy from pendingbusiness.com (h1, Principles paragraph, 'Membership is by invitation') and the PendingBusiness README on 2026-11-26. Ink from its theme-color #0F0E0C.
headline: A treasury operating system for one
idea: Float capture, last-responsible-moment payments and deterministic cash routing, built for one person and a small group of invited members.

points.title: Float is the product
points.body: Idle money should earn yield every day it isn't needed elsewhere.

points.title: The last responsible moment
points.body: Bills get paid at the last responsible moment, not the first.

points.title: Avalanche, not snowball
points.body: Debt is extinguished by APR-ordered avalanche, not feel-good snowball.

rows.title: Last responsible moment
rows.detail: Bills paid when due, not before
